description: Initialization: Process tasks by descending reward; assign to the satellite with the highest
weighted usable-window record count, valid-window count, assigned-task load and overlap score,
adjusted for candidate scarcity. Ties retain satellite input order.
Reassignment (RKHMA-inspired adaptation, not the original coordinator):
- Ranking: Score unscheduled tasks using reward, non-owner candidate count, window count and
seeded task key; rank targets by window count, duration, earliest start and seeded pair key.
- Replacement and exchange: If migration does not improve the best trial, try removing up to
three low-reward nearby observations or relocating one to another candidate satellite.
- Bundle: Trial pairs of still-unsuccessful tasks on a shared target when earliest window
starts differ by at most 120 seconds.
- Acceptance: Return the feasible trial with highest profit strictly above the current
schedule; retain the first on ties. The runtime repeats from the accepted state.
- Termination: Stop when no trial improves or the search budget expires.
This adaptation does not run the source coordinator or full-satellite recalibration.
